At Hospira (2009-2013), improved Lean documentation management and change control, validated a documentation change-control database, and remediated production and quality-system software validation. At Western Union (2005-2009), led five systems support engineers; supported operations in the Dominican Republic and Jamaica and establishment of the Omaha support group. Troubleshot DOS, C++, and MySQL applications; this does not establish authorship of those applications. Skills include AI applications and agents, web development, Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, AI-assisted VS Code development, AWS and Azure fundamentals, systems analysis and design, project and program management, consulting, Lean, value stream mapping, auditing, and risk management. MS Information Management completed June 2026 with a 4.0 GPA; Codecademy Full-Stack Engineer completed October 10, 2026 and AI Engineer November 1, 2026.
